major_cooldowns.name: Berserk
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Sync it with Tiger's Fury, enter it near empty energy, and spend the extra combo points it feeds you on Ferocious Bite.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 106951 is the cast and self aura seen in 5/5 sampled parses; 343216 and 1269349 share the name and were not observed.

major_cooldowns.name: Tiger's Fury
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Spend down to low energy first, then press it on cooldown and apply Rip and Rake inside it so they snapshot its 15% damage buff.

major_cooldowns.name: Convoke the Spirits
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Channel it with every dot already applied and Tiger's Fury running, then follow it with Ferocious Bite.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 391528 is the cast in 5/5 sampled parses; 323764 shares the name and is the version the guide's cooldown section links.

major_cooldowns.name: Feral Frenzy
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Hold it for Tiger's Fury so its bleed snapshots the buff, otherwise press it on cooldown.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 274837 is the cast; 274838 is the bleed aura of the same name.

major_cooldowns.name: Incarnation: Avatar of Ashamane
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: When you take it over Berserk, sync it with Tiger's Fury and use its free in-combat Prowl for a stealth Rake inside the 20 second window.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Castable per its tooltip but not pressed in the sampled parses; it replaces Berserk when talented.

major_cooldowns.name: Frantic Frenzy
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: On several targets press it on cooldown, and delay Tiger's Fury by up to 2 seconds when that lines the two up.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 1243807 is the castable id per its tooltip; 1244023, 1244079 and 1278969 share the name and were not observed.

rule.description: Rake, Shred, Berserk, Rip, then Convoke in the opener
rule.action: Rake from stealth, build to full combo points with Shred, then Berserk and Tiger's Fury before Rip and Convoke.
Press Tiger's Fury in the same window as Berserk so the whole burst carries its damage buff.

rule.description: Convoke the Spirits synced with Tiger's Fury
rule.action: Send Convoke with Tiger's Fury running and your dots already applied.
Wait for Tiger's Fury before Feral Frenzy so its bleed snapshots the buff.

rule.description: Ferocious Bite only at full combo points
rule.action: Build to full combo points before you bite, and get Rip running first.
Pool to 50 energy before biting so it spends the extra 25 and doubles its damage.
Spend down to low energy before you press it so none of its 50 energy restore is wasted.

rule.description: Keep Rip up on the target
rule.action: Refresh Rip in its pandemic window at full combo points, under Tiger's Fury when it is up.

rule.description: Keep Rake up on the target
rule.action: Reapply Rake as soon as it enters pandemic so it never falls off.

rule.description: Refresh Rake late, never clip it
rule.action: Let Rake run into its last 30% before refreshing, unless Tiger's Fury or Prowl just gave you a stronger snapshot.

rule.description: Spend Apex Predator's Craving on Ferocious Bite
rule.action: Bite the moment the proc lands, since it is free and already deals maximum damage.

rule.description: Primal Wrath spreads Rip on several targets
rule.action: Apply Rip with Primal Wrath once several enemies are up instead of ripping them one at a time.

rule.description: Swipe over Shred once several enemies are up
rule.action: Build combo points with Swipe once the pack is up and keep Shred for single target.
